paragraphs.text: # dsh-fat-fish
English | 中文
A draggable fish-maid desk pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. It reminds you to drink water and st
and up, keeps a small daily log, and reacts to how often you actually do those things.
## Features

- A floating, draggable desk pet with idle bobbing, blinking, bubbles, and a forward-swim dash.
- Wa

ter and walk reminders with configurable intervals, pause/resume, snooze, and one-click logging.
- D

aily water/walk counts plus a compact recent-history view.
- Custom avatar import: PNG, JPG, WebP, a

nd GIF; resized locally to 1024px and stored only in this browser.
- Free pet scaling from 60% to 20

0%; default 165%.
- Frequency-aware inner monologue, meme-flavored thoughts, and rapid-click roasts.
- An original Manbo-style chime synthesized with Web Audio. No third-party recordings or samples ar

e bundled.
- Settings, history, avatar, scale, and position survive reloads through `localStorage`.
## Requirements

- DSH Web with the `shell.overlay` slot (tested with DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`).
- No build step and no extra

with the `shell.overlay` slot (tested with DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`).
- No build step and no extra services.
## Install
The package is a ready-to-install DSH bundle. Once it is listed in the DSH Plugin Market, install it
there. For local development, install the package directory through the DSH plugin manager.
## Sound and privacy
- The reminder chime is generated at runtime with the Web Audio API. It is an original Manbo-style c

omposition, not a copy of any existing recording or melody.
- Reminder schedules, daily counts, sett
ings, avatar, scale, and position stay in browser `localStorage`. The plugin makes no network reques
ts for these features.
## Development
The repository is the package root. There is no build step: edit `client.js` and the locale files, t
hen install the directory with the DSH plugin manager.
## License
Code is MIT-licensed. The bundled default character artwork and plugin icon are covered by the asset
notice in NOTICE.md.
